mintAuthority.summary: AA_FalconXUSDC is an IdleCDOTranche token whose shares are minted exclusively by the IdleCDO contract (0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d) against USDC deposits. The CDO is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy; upgrades require 24h OZ Timelock (0xda86e15d0cda3a05db930b248d7a2f775e575a44). CDO owner is Idle Finance Safe 8/3. Tranche tokens cannot be minted independently of CDO deposits. Base USDC supply is inherited from Circle.
